crossRefs.note: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven…
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
